parent_voice: Independent Qwen VoiceDesign D + Qwen3-TTS Base
intent: Slightly lower and fuller, with a natural conversational delivery. Preserve emphasis, phrasing, and breaths.
formants: shift coherently with pitch; no target-speaker conversion
performance_rule: Design emotion and phrasing for the episode. This profile adjusts vocal body; it does not prescribe one performance for every topic.
processing_rule: Process within verified quiet boundaries with context on each side. Preserve the total sample count. Do not regenerate each sentence separately.
level_rule: Match the source narration loudness and limit isolated reconstruction peaks. Do not use a volume increase to suggest a deeper voice.
approval_rule: D plus body-v1 is approved for the series. Keep the voice identity stable while adapting delivery to the content. Measurements do not replace listening.
